info.name: Teachworks API
info.description: Welcome to the Teachworks API! This API allows Teachworks users to build custom integrations to interact with data from their Teachworks accounts. Teachworks provides business management software for education companies. You can find more information on our website here: Teachworks. If you have questions you can contact us at support@teachworks.com.

item.name: General Information
Usage Policy
item.description:
The Teachworks API is intended to be used as an interface to connect a Teachworks account with another software program. 

The Teachworks API is not intended for backing up records -- backups can be created within Teachworks using the Excel downloads feature. 

Excessive requests or retrieving records in a continuous loop is not permitted.

item.name: Request/Response Format
item.description: The default response format is JSON. Requests with a message-body use plain JSON to set or update resource attributes. Successful requests will return a 200 OK HTTP status.

item.name: Pagination
item.description:
Requests that return multiple items will be paginated to 20 items by default. This default can be changed using the “per_page” parameter up to a maximum of 80 items.

	GET /students?per_page=15

You can specify further pages with the ?page parameter:

	GET /students?page=2

Page number is 1-based and omitting the ?page parameter will return the first page.

item.name: Order
item.description:
By default results are returned in ascending order ("asc") on the primary id column. You can also order results in descending order with the "direction" parameter set to "desc":

	GET /students?direction=desc

item.name: Errors
item.description:
Occasionally you might encounter errors when accessing the API. There are four possible types:
Error Code Error Type
400 Bad Request Invalid request, e.g. using unsupported HTTP method or data has validation errors
401 Unauthorized Authentication or permission error, e.g. incorrect API token
403 Forbidden Requests to resources that don't exist or requests that exceed the rate-limit
404 Not Found Requests to resources that don't exist or are missing
500 Internal Sever Error Server error
Errors return both an appropriate HTTP status code and response object which contains a code, message and data attribute.

item.name: Rate Limiting
item.description: API calls are rate-limited by API token at 4 requests per second.

You can access the Teachworks API at:

	{{base_url}}

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Teachworks uses API tokens to allow access to the API. You can generate an API token for your Teachworks account by going to the API section on the Integrations & Add-ons page.

The Teachworks API uses bearer authorization and requires an Authorization header containing you API token to be included in each request. The header should use the following format:

```
-H 'Authorization: Token token=api_token'

 ```

**Note: You must replace "api_token" above with your account's API token.**

All API requests must be made over HTTPS. Calls made over plain HTTP will fail.

API requests without authentication will also fail.

include_as_teacher Set to true if employee_type is "Staff" and employee also teaches lessons.

additional_notesAdditional notes about the client
birth_date Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

position Position or job title
bio Biographical details that can be displayed in website plugins
wage_type Method for calculating wage for lessons. "Employee Wage" or "Service List Wage".
Defaults to "Service List Wage".
